sql:
SELECT COUNT(c.id)
FROM comments AS c
WHERE c.postid IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM posts
    WHERE score = (SELECT MAX(score) FROM posts)
)

sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.element = 'o') AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bond AS b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND b.bond_type = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS counts

sql:
WITH per_user_post AS (
  SELECT ph.userid, ph.postid, COUNT(*) AS history_count, MAX(p.viewcount) AS viewcount
  FROM posthistory AS ph
  JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = ph.postid
  GROUP BY ph.userid, ph.postid
)
SELECT u.displayname
FROM users AS u
JOIN per_user_post AS x ON x.userid = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.displayname
HAVING BOOL_AND(x.history_count = 1)
   AND BOOL_OR(x.history_count = 1 AND x.viewcount >= 1000)

sql:
WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.a11
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
oldest_birth_date AS (
    SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS birth_date
    FROM female_clients
),
salary_extremes AS (
    SELECT MIN(a11) AS lowest_salary, MAX(a11) AS highest_salary
    FROM district
)
SELECT a.account_id, se.highest_salary - se.lowest_salary AS gap
FROM female_clients AS fc
JOIN oldest_birth_date AS ob ON fc.birth_date = ob.birth_date
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = fc.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
CROSS JOIN salary_extremes AS se
WHERE fc.a11 = se.lowest_salary

WITH banned_counts AS (
  SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_count
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
),
top_format AS (
  SELECT format
  FROM banned_counts
  ORDER BY banned_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN top_format AS t ON t.format = l.format
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
ORDER BY l.format, c.name

WITH banned_counts AS (
  SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_count
  FROM legalities
  WHERE status = 'Banned'
  GROUP BY format
), top_formats AS (
  SELECT format
  FROM banned_counts
  ORDER BY banned_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN top_formats AS t ON t.format = l.format
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
ORDER BY l.format, c.name

JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedmanacost = (
      SELECT MAX(c2.convertedmanacost)
      FROM cards AS c2
      JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setcode
      WHERE s2.name = 'Coldsnap'
  )
ORDER BY fd.name

FROM foreign_data AS fd
CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(fd.type, '\s*[—–]\s*|,\s*') AS part
WHERE fd.language = 'German'
  AND fd.type IS NOT NULL
  AND fd.type <> ''
  AND trim(part) <> ''
ORDER BY type
